scope: Manuscript revision around the verified motion-conditioned freshness pattern; no robot run, new physical trial, or altered observation.
core_findings: Spatial command-estimated separation and motion-conditioned semantic freshness are distinct observed operating properties.
The observed AEGIS completion-time cost increases under the tested slow update cadence.
Additional score-held software intervals account arithmetically for most of the recorded time increase, not independently measured physical standstill.
manuscript_changes: Abstract, introduction, outcome definition, results, discussion and conclusions aligned with the three findings.
Main Table 2 includes cutoff-free mean moving-decision age, generated from the verified post-hoc audit.
Supplement S14 adds all 24 primary per-run mean ages, nominal contrast sensitivity, pilot consistency and retained older-evidence exceptions.
Supplement Figure S2 shows all nominal normal-to-slow changes; main Figures 1-4 and their measured values are preserved.
Assumption-dependent sign-reference p-values removed from the active article and supplementary table; descriptive differences retained.
The definition-sensitive first-detection diagnostic remains in the supplement rather than serving as the main result.
scientific_boundaries_retained: Capture-proxy age rather than independently validated sensor-exposure age.
Software-state occupancy rather than physical stopping or hazard-exposure duration.
No universal age bound; all missing-detection old-evidence exceptions remain included.
No demonstrated collision-risk reduction, whole-arm guarantee, or superiority over fixed-buffer-plus-timeout.
Small nonrandomized same-session experiment; nominal matching and leave-one-out checks are descriptive.
Human-reviewed replay remains same-session, model-stratified and operator-reviewed.
Author ethics-applicability and public-data permissions are not fabricated or declared resolved.
